newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends down $3.75 after wet Brent tumble.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends down $3.75 after wet Brent tumble.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures settled $3.75 a tonne lower on the nearby November contract after downward pressure on Brent added to strong selling of NYMEX gasoline.
The November contract last traded at $223.00, just off the day's lows, after Brent traded at what some dealers said was an unexpectedly low level.
A wet Brent cargo traded at 43 cents under December, which compares to the equivalent of 60 cents over December which traded about a week ago.
December Brent futures was down 48 cents at $23.70 a barrel at 1800 GMT, having hit a high earlier in the day of $24.12.
"Fundamentals are threatening but the key technical levels held reasonably well today," said Tim Holmes of brokers MeesPierson Derivatives in London.
He said $222.00 on November gas oil, today's low, and the area around $23.70 on December Brent were important technical support levels.
"Brent managed to climb back above $23.70 but the physical market does look weak," he added.
